messages:
tay: Heads-up: premerge SAST/DAST for PR #6230 flagged template-injection patterns on render-service. artifact: gs://ci/6230/report.json

leo: can you paste the snippet?

tay: 
```
SAST: render.go:102 fmt.Sprintf(tpl, userInput) -> potential template injection
DAST: /api/render POST shows evaluated expressions in response body
```

anya: tagging infra — any recent KMS or RBAC changes for staging keystore?

oncall-sre: no RBAC flips, but we did a key refresh last night. I can run a repro in staging and capture audit logs.

security-bot: scan summary: 1 HIGH (template injection), 4 MED. Suggested triage: assign owner, reproduce, attach KMS audit.

leo: I'll own SAST triage and open a quick PR to stop using fmt.Sprintf on user templates.

tay: I'll create ticket SEC-9011 and attach artifact + request audit logs.

anya: if repro matches, mitigation = reject templates containing {{ }} and migrate to safe template engine.

oncall-sre: starting ephemeral grant window at 21:00 UTC for 20m to assist repro. Audit will include key IDs.

leo: local repro steps and minimal test added to ticket. Opening WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood/render/pull/912

security-bot: Remember to reference SEC-9011 in keystore-change log for the ephemeral grant.

tay: thanks team — will update SEC-9011 with verification and close once premerge scans are clean.
